interpretation.attachedAsset: Current painter has a distinct wearable/held-prop asset for the selected item age and slot.
interpretation.staticBakedWeapon: The body plate contains a weapon, so the painter suppresses the selected-item layer; item-specific replacement is not visible.
interpretation.socketOnly: The item is recorded in its slot, but no current item-specific body layer is bound.

limits: The all-slots-worn rows are synthetic source-consumer fixtures. They verify current bindings and file integrity, not natural acquisition, equip persistence, pixel fit, motion integration, or owner acceptance. Existing natural Future Knight captures are reviewed separately.
